nodes.label: MRAgent
nodes.author: Ji, Li, Hooi
nodes.rationale: Takes the reconstructive view of human memory literally, using an LLM to iteratively expand and prune graph paths rather than a one-shot fixed-hop retrieval.

nodes.label: Cue-Tag-Content memory graph
nodes.rationale: Explicit Tag nodes bridge fine-grained cues and content so the LLM can prune promising associative directions before touching expensive content nodes, avoiding combinatorial blow-up.

nodes.label: Active vs passive retrieval expressiveness theorem
nodes.rationale: Proves via a Binary-Tree Needle-in-a-Haystack construction that active (evidence-conditioned) retrieval strictly out-expresses any fixed-budget non-adaptive passive policy.
